dedupe_keys.name: cambodia evacuation sites in pursat and oddar meanchey provinces 2015 hdx

description: This dataset maps community evacuation sites in two Cambodian provinces: sites in Pursat collected by People in Need and sites in Oddar Meanchey collected by the disaster risk reduction partners with ActionAid. It was shared in 2015 through the Humanitarian Response platform for Cambodia and is now published by OCHA's Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Coverage is those two provinces only. The site points are free to download as a zipped shapefile of about 48 kB. The licence is marked Other and points to the legacy Humanitarian Response terms of use. Caveats: the data date from 2015, coverage is partial and project-based, and attributes such as capacity are limited to what the partners recorded. Simulation uses: locating flood evacuation destinations in Cambodian provinces exposed to Mekong and Tonle Sap flooding, and testing access to shelters in evacuation models. Related records: the Fiji evacuation tracking data (data-iom-dtm-fiji-evacuation-tracking-cycle-2-2016) describe shelter use after a cyclone and the Japan designated evacuation places (data-japan-designated-emergency-evacuation-places-and-shelters-p04076) are a national shelter list.
